messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: gpu-pool-us-east-1 prefill OOM spike detected (container restarts). Priority: P1. Pager: sarah_oncall. Links: https://internal.alerts/5172468000

sarah_oncall: on it. seeing a spike in node restarts in prefill-svc. starting triage.

raj_eng: can you post the logs from the affected container? suspect long prompts + kv cache growth.

emily_sre: copy — collecting docker logs and nvidia-smi snapshots. I see repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` and a kernel driver reset on host gpu-17.

mike_runtime: throwing this here — we've had a regression with prefix prefill unbounded for some request patterns. Newer policy didn't enforce max_prefill_tokens.

sarah_oncall: impact? any customer-facing errors yet?

claire_cs: support queue has two customers reporting generation failures and reconnects in last 10m. no outage reported but UX breaks.

raj_eng: logs (snip):
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] prefill-svc container 7f1a2c: prefill request id=rx-9a3 tokens=98542
[2026-03-15T10:12:04Z] Allocating KV cache 45.3GiB
[2026-03-15T10:12:04Z] CUDA error: out of memory (cuMemAlloc)
[2026-03-15T10:12:04Z] Runtime: container restart triggered (exit code 137)
[2026-03-15T10:12:05Z] kubelet: pod prefill-abc evicted / restarted
```

mike_runtime: that token count is huge — looks like a user sent a concatenated transcript. system should clamp. we disabled the prefiller backpressure earlier this week while ramping throughput.

emily_sre: mitigation options (short-term):
- enable node-level eviction to drop largest prefill tasks
- scale up pool with spare nodes (hot-add GPUs)
- apply runtime env change to set PREFILL_TOKEN_LIMIT=4096 and roll across pods
- fall back traffic to smaller instance pool that enforces per-request caps

sarah_oncall: what can we do immediately? I can flip config if someone approves.

raj_eng: approve the PREFILL_TOKEN_LIMIT change. also remove automatic large-kv allocations until we patch. patch will be ready in ~40m.

mike_runtime: rolling change:
```
kubectl set env deploy/prefill-svc PREFILL_TOKEN_LIMIT=4096 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deploy/prefill-svc -n prod --grace-period=30
```

emily_sre: executing now. restarting 25 pods with max surge 5. watching logs.

(30s later)

emily_sre: rollout in progress, ~6 pods restarted, still seeing a few OOMs as in-flight requests requeue. throttling new prefill requests at the gateway for 2 min.

dave_support: sending a brief customer update: "We’re seeing elevated failures for long-context generation, actively mitigating — no data loss. ETA next update 20m."

claire_cs: ack, I'll post to impacted customers and include workaround: reduce request size / chunk input.

raj_eng: added a temporary patch to reject requests with prefill tokens > 20k at API layer to catch bad clients. pushing now.

mike_runtime: also enabling prefix-KV eviction to trim cached kv at 12GB per-request to avoid single-request taking whole GPU.

emily_sre: monitoring nvidia-smi on gpu-17: memory usage falling to normal after pods settle. observed one host kernel reset earlier, but it's stable now.

sarah_oncall: any ongoing restarts?

emily_sre: last restart timestamp 2026-03-15T10:22:18Z; none since 10:24. marking mitigated for now.

raj_eng: root cause hypothesis: a combination of disabled prefill backpressure + unbounded client payloads created single-request KV memory exhaustion triggering CUDA OOM and container OOM.

mike_runtime: follow-ups:
- revert the backpressure disable and add test coverage for unbounded prefill sequences
- implement soft prefill quota at gateway (reject early) + server-side clamp
- add an autoscaler policy for transient prefill spikes to prefer provisioning vs eviction

sarah_oncall: action items assigned:
- raj_eng: patch and tests for backpressure (ETA 3d)
- mike_runtime: autoscaler policy proposal (ETA 5d)
- emily_sre: churned host(s) review and driver logs, file infra postmortem if driver resets reoccur (ETA 1d)
- claire_cs/dave_support: customer follow-ups and post-incident comms (ETA next update 1h)

claire_cs: sending final customer note now — include mitigation & recommended client changes.

emily_sre: adding incident tag and linking logs to internal incident page: https://incidents.redwood/5172468000

incident-bot: Incident 5172468000 updated: status=mitigated, severity=P1 -> investigating-> mitigated. Postmortem scheduled.

sarah_oncall: closing oncall loop. I'll draft timeline and hand off to eng for postmortem. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
